newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: ALPINE SKIING-SLOVENIA KEEPS WORLD CUP RACES.
newsitem.headline: ALPINE SKIING-SLOVENIA KEEPS WORLD CUP RACES.

text.p: Two men's Alpine skiing World Cup races which were in doubt for January 5 and 6 in Kranjska Gora will proceed as scheduled, the International Ski Federation (FIS) said on Monday.

The FIS had given the organisers until Monday to determine if conditions would allow the Slovenian resort to stage the first two men's races of the new year -- a slalom and a giant slalom -- or risk losing them to Veysonnaz, Switzerland.

The FIS also said a women's downhill originally scheduled for December 20 in Crans Montana, Switzerland, but postponed because of soft snow would be added to the programme in Bad Kleinkirchheim, Austria.
The race will be the first of back-to-back downhills on January 10 and 11 followed by a super giant slalom on January 12.
